correctness.rationale: For m<=a every length-m S-module is killed by m^a; at length a+1, fM nonzero forces all a+1 graded pieces of the m-adic filtration to be one-dimensional, hence a unique cyclic curvilinear module structure. Each F_q tangent direction supports q^(a-1) distinct ideals; the f relation excludes exactly those with f_a(u,v) nonzero. Framing each cyclic quotient contributes q^(a(n-1)) (q^n-1)/(q-1) kernels, establishing the exact all-field/rank difference. Small q=2 n=1,2 exhaustive independent matrix enumeration confirms cusp, split-node and nonsplit-node specializations. The finite test is not an infinite proof.
